findings.text: _ids_vacuum_field re-expresses the b0-size selection (one value for the IDS, else one per slice) that nova/imas/getslice.py:11 vacuum_field owns in this same change, instead of calling it, so the rule the node consolidated to one owner still has two statements and the evidence fragment's claim that both callers read the owner is wrong for this one.

Sample.equilibrium_ids writes psi_boundary, psi1d, dpressure_dpsi and f_df_dpsi into an equilibrium IDS with no write factor; those values now arrive in COCOS 17 from the translated reader, so their stored sign flips by -1 for a DD3 target where before the raw DD3 value passed through unchanged. The file is inside the declared write paths and plan section 4 requires a converted consumer to take its sign from the owner, but the node recorded it as follow-on 1 rather than converting it, so a real write-path regression is disclosed and left open.

the fragment says every arm above was re-run at the head as finally committed; the test_shape_inverse head arm (logs/shape_inverse-two-arms-1294540.log, job 1294540, started 2026-10-23T19:25:15Z) ran before 3b28b8b64, c76777000, c1e7f94ed, 505298bfd, 2319a6e58, bef45f5a6, fa01f7936 and ef1643e61, and 505298bfd changes EquilibriumData.load on a path that test can reach, so the delta claim for that file is not measured at the reviewed revision.

the gate table quotes 94.72 s for test_database and 7.30 s for test_pointconstraint, but the final-head logs the manifest names as that arm read 86.25 s and 5.01 s (logs/final-head-test_database.log, logs/final-head-test_pointconstraint.log), so the record's metrics do not reconcile with the logs a promotion receipt would open.

changed_paths lists eight paths while the diff against the base changes ten: tests/test_database.py and tests/test_pointconstraint.py are both in the landed change and absent from the list, so the record a coordinator audits scope against undercounts it. The required artifacts key is also absent and artifacts_note stands in its place.

the manifest's negative_control_log points at a log whose last line is a pytest summary (1 failed, 1 passed, 45 deselected) and which carries no bare EXIT= line anywhere, so the non-zero status admission reads from that field is not present in the file it names; the failing test id is legible, but the record shape the contract states is not met.

the wall property's dd_version argument has no passing guard: the only test that reaches the wall build is tests/test_equilibrium_reader_cocos.py's strict xfail for an unrelated frame KeyError, so removing the argument again would leave every test green.

int(self.homogeneous_time) is a serialisation fix the reader needs to store an uncached pulse at all, but the brief admits scenario.py for a sign site only, so the node widened the condition it was given rather than stopping to name it; the evidence fragment discloses the change in those terms.
